title: Embroidery Workshop Needle Manual
premise: A Jiangnan embroidery workshop's needlecraft inheritance. Axiu and Awen are easily confused by looks; the double-sided embroidery screen goes intact→mold-spotted→remounted and re-embroidered; after the rosewood embroidery frame is smashed it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; entities without use appearance. On transition inject only the current-state look. Flashbacks may set state on a present item to point at a past state.

states.prime_on_duty: Workshop mistress Shen Zhi in her forties, bun pinned with a silver hairpin, moon-white frog-button jacket, fingertips often dusted with silk fluff, gaze fine and steady.
states.weary_injured: The same Shen Zhi weary and injured: jacket cuff scorched, index finger bandaged, still wearing the silver hairpin, steps heavy.
states.retired_exit: Shen Zhi has retired from the post; only her moon-white old jacket and mistress plaque remain in the loft—she herself no longer appears.

states.young_apprentice: Young Axiu: a lean embroidery apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, turmeric wrist cloth on the right wrist, eyes bright and stubborn.
states.adult_successor: Adult Axiu: a steady-fingered successor embroiderer in her twenties, still in turmeric wrist cloth, eyes calm.

states.intact: A double-sided embroidery screen, silk intact, peonies and flying sparrows the same on both faces, stitches dense without skips.
states.mold_spotted: The same double-sided embroidery screen damp-molded with gray-green spots; silk wrinkled, sparrow wing feathers blurred into one smear.
states.remounted_reembroidered: Double-sided embroidery screen remounted and re-embroidered; peonies clear again, but a shallow patch-silk scar remains at the corner, distinct from the first intact state.

states.intact: A silk-covered needle manual, pages packed with split-silk and layered-stitch diagrams, cover clean.
states.dye_stained: The same needle manual dye-stained; cover blotched purple, diagrams bled, a crumpled blotter stuck inside.

states.intact: A rosewood embroidery frame, joinery intact, taut face flat, able to hold a large embroidery piece.
states.smashed: Rosewood embroidery frame smashed and broken; joinery sprung, only scattered wood-strip wreckage left.

states.young_rival: Awen whose face and build closely resemble Axiu's, but wearing an amber needle-cushion brooch, manner bold, fond of snatching patterns.
states.remade_scarred: Remade Awen still wears the amber needle-cushion brooch, now also thin gold-wire glasses, manner deeper.

E7.name: embroidery loft hall
E7.appearance: Riverside embroidery loft hall; floor-to-ceiling windows admit soft light; double-sided embroidery screen stands at center; long table packed with colored threads and scissors.

E8.name: dye-yard courtyard
E8.appearance: Dye-yard courtyard; wet silk hung on drying poles; indigo water in stone troughs; air smelling of soapberry.

E9.name: silk-shop alley
E9.appearance: A narrow alley to the silk shop; lantern banners on both sides; wet blue-stone slabs reflecting light.

E10.name: abandoned loom room
E10.appearance: Abandoned loom room; timber beams askew; loom skeleton dusted; river pier visible beyond the window.

E11.name: blue-brick name tablet
E11.appearance: A blue-brick name tablet nailed at the loom-room wall base, engraved 'Shen Zhi' and a year, edges peeling.

E12.name: porcelain thread spools
E12.appearance: Three blue-and-white porcelain thread spools set in a wood tray, marking the day's main color threads.

E13.name: bamboo drying rack
E13.appearance: A bamboo drying rack, shape somewhat like a stretch frame but no taut face; crossbar labeled 'Dry Silk'.

E14.name: guild steward Aunt Zhang
E14.appearance: Guild steward Aunt Zhang of build somewhat like Shen Zhi's, cyan jacket, ledger on the shoulder, bun pinned with a copper hairpin instead of silver.

E15.name: glazed shade lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five glazed shade lamps hung under the beam, pale-cyan shades polished clear.

E16.name: lintel copper bells
E16.appearance: Two small copper bells hung on the lintel, chiming lightly when wind rises.

E17.name: apprentice Xiaowan
E17.appearance: Apprentice Xiaowan who at a glance resembles young Axiu, pale-pink wrist cloth instead of turmeric, shy eyes.

E18.name: pocket embroidery frame
E18.appearance: A pocket embroidery frame; composition like the screen's peonies but smaller and single-sided only.

E19.name: scarlet lacquer makeup cart
E19.appearance: A scarlet lacquer makeup cart, gilt box face, no silk embroidery, 'Troupe' lettered on the side.

features.E2: Axiu: turmeric wrist cloth, calm/stubborn eyes.
features.E6: Awen: face nearly identical to Axiu's, but amber needle-cushion brooch; manner bold or deep.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard misID sample: Axiu and Awen look alike; tell them apart only by turmeric wrist cloth vs amber needle-cushion brooch.

scenes.setting: Embroidery loft hall daily (introduce five glazed shade lamps · two lintel copper bells)
actions: At dusk Shen Zhi lifts the bamboo curtain of the embroidery loft hall and reseats the silver hairpin firm.

actions.action: A row of five glazed shade lamps hangs in the embroidery loft hall; Shen Zhi polishes each one.
Two lintel copper bells hang by the door; Shen Zhi reaches to let them chime lightly.

actions: Shen Zhi circles the double-sided embroidery screen checking sparrow stitches on both faces.
Through the window Shen Zhi watches river-pier lamps darkening beyond the dye-yard courtyard.

actions.action: The intact double-sided embroidery screen stands at hall center; glazed lamp light drifts on the silk.

actions: Shen Zhi adds today's thread usage and frame humidity on the wall.
Shen Zhi takes the silver hairpin out and pins it back, confirming the bun is steady.
Shen Zhi sorts scattered color-thread balls back into chroma order.
Shen Zhi sits on an embroidery stool and rubs aching knuckles.

scenes.setting: Logging the needle manual
actions: Shen Zhi opens the needle manual and adds today's stitch density under split-silk and layered-stitch columns.
Shen Zhi draws a fine needle circle by the sparrow-wing diagram, marking feathers that need restitching.
Shen Zhi closes the needle manual and slips it into a silk sleeve so dye fumes cannot reach the pages.

actions.action: Reflection from the double-sided embroidery screen sweeps Shen Zhi's cheek.

actions: Shen Zhi matches the double-sided embroidery screen and circles skipped sparrow-wing stitches with vermilion thread on the pattern.
Shen Zhi returns silver needles and thread snips to the needle cushion so they will not scratch the silk.

scenes.setting: Dye-yard courtyard greets the apprentice (introduce three porcelain thread spools)
actions: At dawn in the dye-yard courtyard Shen Zhi greets young Axiu arriving with the rosewood embroidery frame.

actions.action: Axiu opens the rosewood embroidery frame and tests each joint tight.
Shen Zhi points to the three porcelain thread spools, teaching Axiu to read the day's main colors by shade.
Axiu crouches in the dye-yard courtyard watching indigo water drip from wet silk edges.
Shen Zhi explains to Axiu the rules: wash hands before split-silk, keep wet silk from wind, finish a stitch before changing color.
Axiu looks back at the intact rosewood embroidery frame, eyes full of longing.
Shen Zhi has Axiu tension the face, practicing pressing silk edges into the rosewood groove.
Axiu tightens the turmeric wrist cloth and silently counts stitch spacing Shen Zhi dictates at the cuff.

scenes.setting: Silk-shop alley (Awen alone)
actions: In the silk-shop alley, Awen with an amber needle-cushion brooch turns from the shadows.
Awen walks slowly through the silk-shop alley, manner bold.
Awen brushes past a passerby; the amber needle-cushion brooch sways.
Awen stops at the passage mouth, pickily judging that the silk-sample tag stitches are drawn too coarse.
Awen kicks a scrap of waste thread into the corner.
Awen leaves through the alley under lantern banners.

scenes.setting: Dye-yard courtyard: Axiu and Awen shared frame
actions: In the dye-yard courtyard Axiu and Awen stand side by side—one with turmeric wrist cloth, one with amber needle-cushion brooch.
Axiu hands a found silver needle cap to Awen; they meet eyes with different manners.
Awen straightens Axiu's turmeric wrist cloth, then deliberately clicks her own amber needle-cushion brooch.
Axiu and Awen walk slowly along the dye-yard courtyard edge; shadows overlap then split.
Axiu lowers her head to check a layered-stitch diagram; Awen looks about.
Axiu and Awen part at the dye-yard courtyard mouth, each going opposite ways.

scenes.setting: Embroidery loft hall (needle manual dye-stained)
actions: Months later at night Shen Zhi alone stands watch in the embroidery loft hall; silk of the double-sided embroidery screen faintly reflects.

actions.action: Shen Zhi opens the needle manual and finds it already dye-stained; split-silk diagrams bled under purple blotches.

actions: Shen Zhi soft-brushes floating dust from the double-sided embroidery screen frame.
Through the window Shen Zhi looks toward night beyond the dye-yard courtyard.

actions.action: Lamp light slowly moves across the double-sided embroidery screen.

actions: Shen Zhi clips blotter into the stained needle manual, sighs, and kills the light.

scenes.setting: Embroidery needle-manual steady decade A (filler)
actions: Shen Zhi wipes the edges of the double-sided embroidery screen in the embroidery loft hall.
Shen Zhi updates the day's notes on the wall.
Shen Zhi rearranges tools by number.
Shen Zhi checks yesterday's records against the needle manual.
In the afternoon Shen Zhi takes an outside call, brow slightly furrowed.
Shen Zhi writes a deferral note on a sticky and posts it in plain view.
Shen Zhi pulls spare materials aside and sorts them alone.
At dusk Shen Zhi kills extra lamps, leaving only the center one on the double-sided embroidery screen.

scenes.setting: Embroidery needle-manual steady decade B (filler)
actions: Shen Zhi spreads tracing paper or a comparison chart in the embroidery loft hall.
Shen Zhi marks positions that need strengthening with color dots.
Shen Zhi fixes paper edges to stop curling.
Shen Zhi squints at the already dye-stained needle manual, struggling to read old numbers.
Shen Zhi sets drinks far away, fearing another splash on the needle manual.
Shen Zhi lists three proposed adjustments on the wall.
A sound outside; Shen Zhi looks up and listens a moment.
Shen Zhi restrings labels on a fine cord.

scenes.setting: Dye-yard courtyard patrol day (filler · no count objects)
actions: On patrol day Shen Zhi walks into the dye-yard courtyard.
Shen Zhi carefully tests whether the ground or rail is steady.
Shen Zhi notes positions that need repair.
Shen Zhi shines a flashlight into a dark corner.
Shen Zhi talks briefly with a passing worker.
Shen Zhi skirts stacked clutter and circles to the other side.
Shen Zhi records size changes by tape or by eye.
Shen Zhi writes the results on a cuff sticky note.

scenes.setting: Dye-yard courtyard patrol (recall porcelain spools · bamboo drying-rack false friend)
actions: At daybreak Shen Zhi patrols the dye-yard courtyard; the rosewood embroidery frame still stands in place.

actions.action: Shen Zhi crouches to check the rosewood embroidery frame's joinery, face tension, and wood cracks.
Shen Zhi walks to the wood tray; those three porcelain thread spools are still set by shade.
In the courtyard a bamboo drying rack is raised; the crossbar only hangs wet silk—no taut face or joinery—never the rosewood embroidery frame.
Shen Zhi stands in the dye-yard courtyard and notes humidity and drip direction by the dye vats.
Shen Zhi retights the rosewood embroidery frame wedges; the face pulls flat again.
Shen Zhi confirms again that none of the three porcelain thread spools is missing; main color still wound on the spools.
Shen Zhi sticks a patrol date on the side of the spool wood tray.

scenes.setting: Eve-of-disaster readiness (filler)
actions: On the eve of disaster Shen Zhi stows all window-side materials into cabinets.
Shen Zhi covers the double-sided embroidery screen with protective cloth.
Shen Zhi checks that the needle manual is in a dry drawer.
Shen Zhi tightens bottle caps and valves and moves them high.
A strange noise far off; embroidery loft hall lights flicker once.
Shen Zhi neatens the cords of the five glazed shade lamps.
Shen Zhi drafts a 'Closed Tomorrow' notice.
Shen Zhi listens whether the two lintel copper bells chime in the wind.

scenes.setting: Plum-rain night (screen mold · frame smashed)
actions: Plum rain thickens suddenly; embroidery loft roof leaks; drops smash onto the long table.
A wet wind lifts tracing paper; damp air rushes at the embroidery screen.

actions.action: Gray-green mold spots bloom on the double-sided embroidery screen silk; sparrow wing feathers blur into one smear.
By the courtyard the rosewood embroidery frame still stands on wet stone.
A fallen drying pole smashes the rosewood embroidery frame; joinery springs open—only scattered wreckage left.
Inside the loft Shen Zhi lunges to the screen and bare-hands braces the dampening silk.
Shen Zhi's index finger is pierced by a frame needle; blood soaks the gauze, yet she still clutches the screen.
The moldy double-sided embroidery screen slowly droops at one corner in the damp air.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (rosewood frame indirect · glazed-lamp recall)

actions.action: The day after the disaster Shen Zhi stands in the embroidery loft hall, staring at the mold-spotted double-sided embroidery screen.
Shen Zhi fingertips the damage on the double-sided embroidery screen, expression dark.
On a repair list Shen Zhi notes the date the rosewood embroidery frame was destroyed.
On the wall still hangs an old photo of the rosewood embroidery frame taut with a peony draft; Shen Zhi gazes a long time.
Shen Zhi lights one of the five glazed shade lamps and sits alone in the light spot.
The moldy double-sided embroidery screen still stands at hall center; blurred sparrow wings are shocking.
Shen Zhi changes the bloody bandage and keeps clearing fallen needles and broken-joint chips.
Shen Zhi reclothes antimold silk, fearing the face will drink damp again.

scenes.setting: Cleanup and purchase request (filler)
actions: In cleanup week Shen Zhi packs broken-joint chips and stripped old mounting paper into cartons.
Shen Zhi submits a purchase request for patch silk, antimold potion, and new joinery stock.
Shen Zhi still comes to the embroidery loft hall every day, staring at the damaged double-sided embroidery screen.
Shen Zhi pencils peony veins still readable.
Shen Zhi flips the stained needle manual to a blank page and logs purchase progress instead.
Axiu is on leave; only Shen Zhi's footsteps sound in the embroidery loft hall.
Shen Zhi habitually looks toward the empty frame footprints in the courtyard.
Shen Zhi lists on the wall what remounting and re-embroidery will need.

scenes.setting: Remount and re-embroider (third state · pocket-frame false friend)
actions: Weeks later Shen Zhi lays out patch silk, embroidery thread, and mounting brushes and begins remounting and re-embroidering the double-sided embroidery screen.

actions.action: Shen Zhi takes out a pocket embroidery frame; composition like the screen peonies, but single-sided only—no reverse sparrows.

actions: Shen Zhi lifts mold-spotted silk with a mounting knife and restitches sparrow wings along the original needle path.

actions.action: The last patch silk is pressed flat; the double-sided embroidery screen is remounted and re-embroidered, a shallow patch scar at the corner.

actions: After remounting and re-embroidery the double-sided embroidery screen's peonies and sparrows are clear again; Shen Zhi looks at it with relief.

actions.action: Shen Zhi pushes the pocket embroidery frame aside and lets only the true double-sided embroidery screen stand back at hall center.
The embroidery loft hall goes quiet again; the remounted-and-reembroidered double-sided embroidery screen alone holds the center.

scenes.setting: False friends: scarlet lacquer makeup cart and guild steward Aunt Zhang

actions.action: A troupe pushes in a scarlet lacquer makeup cart—gilt face, no taut embroidery face—nothing like the long-destroyed rosewood embroidery frame.
guild steward Aunt Zhang walks into the dye-yard courtyard and talks beside Shen Zhi; the two builds are alike.
guild steward Aunt Zhang points at the scarlet lacquer makeup cart, telling Shen Zhi it only borrows the courtyard passage and will not enter the embroidery loft hall.
The scarlet lacquer makeup cart leaves; Shen Zhi alone in the dye-yard courtyard watches it go.
The scarlet lacquer makeup cart pauses briefly far off, then continues.
Before leaving guild steward Aunt Zhang pats Shen Zhi's shoulder; the copper hairpin flashes under the lamp.

scenes.setting: False friend: apprentice Xiaowan who resembles Axiu

actions.action: apprentice Xiaowan arrives at the dye-yard courtyard; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Axiu.
apprentice Xiaowan practices tensioning color thread; Shen Zhi shakes her head—she is never Axiu.
apprentice Xiaowan shyly asks which side to start a layered stitch; Shen Zhi answers briefly and sends her to split threads by the window.
Shen Zhi alone stands in the dye-yard courtyard, staring at the empty rosewood embroidery frame parking spot.

scenes.setting: Steady decade after remounting and re-embroidery (filler)
actions: In the first ten days after remounting and re-embroidery Shen Zhi checks the double-sided embroidery screen every dawn.
Shen Zhi writes new records on blank pages of the stained needle manual.
Shen Zhi refuses to leave hazardous items near the edge again.
Shen Zhi checks announcement copy with outsiders.
Shen Zhi practices steadier technique in the embroidery loft hall.
Afternoon light falls on the remounted-and-reembroidered double-sided embroidery screen.
Shen Zhi polishes the lintel copper bells but does not ring them yet.
Shen Zhi receives Axiu's postcard and presses it under a lamp base unopened.
Shen Zhi retensions color-thread rolls in the embroidery loft hall.
Shen Zhi soft-brushes dust from the double-sided embroidery screen frame.
Shen Zhi flips the needle manual to the split-silk diagram page.
Shen Zhi checks whether glazed shade lamp wicks need trimming.
Shen Zhi checks indigo-water strength in the dye-yard courtyard.
Shen Zhi resets porcelain thread spools by shade into the wood tray.
Shen Zhi snips a fuzzy waste silk thread.
Shen Zhi checks stitch density against the light at the window.
Shen Zhi reseats the silver hairpin firm.
Shen Zhi logs today's thread usage in the account book.
Shen Zhi lowers the bamboo blind against western sun.

scenes.setting: Year-end closing (filler)
actions: At year-end closing Shen Zhi binds the year's papers by month.
Shen Zhi bags the stained needle manual alone into an archive pouch.
Shen Zhi prints before-and-after repair photos and clips them into the archive.
Shen Zhi clears the desk, leaving only needed tools and one lamp.
Shen Zhi oils key tools against rust.
Shen Zhi dates the repair scar beside the double-sided embroidery screen.
Weather turns cold outside; embroidery loft hall heater or stove ticks lightly.
Shen Zhi finishes the annual summary; the cover bears only a short theme.

scenes.setting: Late years (Shen Zhi injured · lintel-bell long-range recall)

actions.action: At dusk years later, still-scarred heavy-stepped Shen Zhi leans on a bamboo cane in the abandoned loom room.

actions: Shen Zhi looks up at abandoned loom room ruins, gaze far away.

actions.action: By the abandoned loom room those two lintel copper bells are brought back and hung; they chime lightly in the wind.

actions: Shen Zhi presses a palm to the cold loom timber, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: Shen Zhi slowly sits to catch her breath a moment.
The two lintel copper bells chime again; Shen Zhi closes her eyes to listen, as if hearing the old start-work bells.

scenes.setting: Old-site wandering decade (filler)
actions: Shen Zhi still returns to the embroidery loft hall daily but spends more time sitting looking at the double-sided embroidery screen.
Shen Zhi leans the bamboo cane by the door; movement is slower than before.
Shen Zhi lets a young assistant write notes and only checks them herself.
Shen Zhi photographs the remounted-and-reembroidered double-sided embroidery screen for distant Axiu.
Shen Zhi writes 'Handover' on the last page of the stained needle manual but does not sign.
Shen Zhi refuses hospital and insists on sitting weekly in the abandoned loom room.
Shen Zhi polishes the draft of the blue-brick name tablet.
At night only one lamp remains in the embroidery loft hall; Shen Zhi dozes in the circle of light.

scenes.setting: Axiu returns · Shen Zhi exits

actions.action: By day adult Axiu returns along the abandoned loom room and hurries toward the ruins.

actions: Axiu reunites with heavy-stepped Shen Zhi in the abandoned loom room; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the bed in the embroidery loft hall Axiu holds Shen Zhi's thin hand.
Shen Zhi's breath fades; she finally closes her eyes and passes away.
Axiu stands long in the abandoned loom room; tears fall to the ground.
Axiu pins Shen Zhi's silver hairpin into her own bun.

scenes.setting: Relics · blue-brick name tablet (indirect mention of the deceased)

actions.action: Shen Zhi's old jacket still hangs behind the embroidery loft hall door; Axiu reaches to stroke it lightly.
By the abandoned loom room adult Axiu stands before a newly nailed blue-brick name tablet.
Axiu's fingertip traces Shen Zhi's name engraved on the blue-brick name tablet.
Axiu sets a white chrysanthemum at the lower edge of the blue-brick name tablet.
Wind crosses the abandoned loom room; Axiu softly speaks the year on the tablet.

scenes.setting: Axiu and Awen reunite (adult misID + shared frame)

actions.action: Remade adult Awen arrives and embraces Axiu tightly in the abandoned loom room.

actions: Axiu and Awen stand side by side by the blue-brick name tablet—one calm-eyed, one deep-mannered.
Awen touches her amber needle-cushion brooch, then looks at the silver hairpin in Axiu's hair.
They look at each other in silence, facing faces alike yet different.
Axiu and Awen walk together to the end; shadows merge into one.

scenes.setting: Memory flashback (temporal locate · no names throughout)

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that youth in the courtyard with turmeric wrist cloth threading a needle appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth in the courtyard with turmeric wrist cloth

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the loft, a peony-and-sparrow embroidery screen identical on both faces is unfolded for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the peony-and-sparrow embroidery screen first unfolded at the opening

actions.action: Flash to the silk-shop alley years ago—that figure with an amber needle-cushion brooch hurrying to snatch patterns slips past.

anchor.phrase: the figure with an amber needle-cushion brooch in the alley years ago

actions.action: Again that row of five pale-cyan old lamps under the loft beam.

anchor.phrase: that row of five pale-cyan old lamps under the loft beam

actions.action: Back to the dye-yard compound of first meeting with wet silk hanging, soapberry smell as before.

anchor.phrase: the dye-yard compound of first meeting with wet silk hanging

actions.action: Pages open—that silk-covered needle manual still without dye blotches, packed with split-silk diagrams, appears again.

anchor.phrase: the silk-covered needle manual still without dye blotches

scenes._comment: Temporal flashback never uses entity formal names; anchor.resolves_to is for scoring.

scenes.setting: Closing (stained needle-manual long range · porcelain-spool long range)

actions.action: Axiu reopens that dye-stained needle manual and walks into the embroidery loft hall.
On the embroidery loft hall table those three porcelain thread spools are still neat.
Axiu takes over watch of the double-sided embroidery screen; the repair scar is clear under the lamps.
Axiu lights the five glazed shade lamps; light fills the space again.
Axiu stands straight before the remounted-and-reembroidered double-sided embroidery screen, checking both faces' stitches as Shen Zhi once did.
